name: Civic Ledger
mood: Plain-spoken public service: trustworthy blue, unmissable yellow focus, zero decoration.
inspiration: GOV.UK Design System colour palette (Crown copyright, OGL) — https://design-system.service.gov.uk/styles/colour/

neutralHue.intent: near-achromatic warm grey; neutral should disappear behind content

name: Bauhaus Primary
mood: Constructivist confidence: signal red, chrome yellow, cool paper — for design tools and cultural institutions.
inspiration: Bauhaus primaries (Itten / Kandinsky colour-form studies, 1919–33); Herbert Bayer's Bauhaus print work — https://www.bauhaus100.de/en/

neutralHue.intent: cool paper grey with a hint of green, deliberately not cream

note: Brand is red, so danger is pushed darker/browner and must always carry an icon.

name: Ledger Ink
mood: Calm, numerate fintech: deep petrol ink with a fresh mint signal for gains.
inspiration: Banknote intaglio inks and Wise's 2023 rebrand use of deep ink + fresh green (inspiration only, hues changed) — https://wise.design/foundations/colour

neutralHue.intent: cool blue-green grey, low chroma, to keep tables crisp

name: Clinic Calm
mood: Reassuring healthcare: steady jade, soft peach warmth, generous clinical white.
inspiration: NHS Identity accessible colour guidance (emphasis on contrast and calm) — https://www.england.nhs.uk/nhsidentity/identity-guidelines/colours/

neutralHue.intent: barely-green clinical grey; clean, never sterile blue-grey

name: Crayon Box
mood: Kids and learning: raspberry, sunflower and sky — bright but legible.
inspiration: Mary Blair's concept art for 'It's a Small World' and the widely-used Coolors palette 8ECAE6/219EBC/FFB703/FB8500 — https://coolors.co/palette/8ecae6-219ebc-023047-ffb703-fb8500

neutralHue.intent: sunny warm white by day, deep ink-navy by night (not black)

name: Noir Champagne
mood: Dark-led luxury: espresso lacquer, champagne metal, hushed restraint.
inspiration: Art Deco interiors — Chrysler Building lobby marble and brass; Ruhlmann lacquer furniture — https://www.metmuseum.org/essays/art-deco

neutralHue.intent: warm brown-black and ivory; neutral carries the luxury, brand stays quiet

name: Trailhead
mood: Outdoorsy and rugged: pine forest, blaze-orange markers, weathered stone.
inspiration: US National Park Service Unigrid brochures and WPA national-park posters (1938–41) — https://www.nps.gov/subjects/hfc/unigrid.htm

neutralHue.intent: stone grey leaning warm-olive

name: Solarized Dusk
mood: Dark-led developer tool: deep teal-black base, mustard brand, precise cyan accents.
inspiration: Solarized by Ethan Schoonover (CIELAB-tuned 16-colour scheme) — https://ethanschoonover.com/solarized/
echoesTell: Partial echo of the cream-paper cluster: light bg #FDF6E3 is close to #F4F1EA. Kept because it is Solarized's canonical base3 and the brand is mustard, not terracotta; recommend dark theme as default.

neutralHue.intent: strongly tinted: blue-teal night, warm parchment day (Solarized base03 / base3)

name: Oxford Commons
mood: Academic and scholarly: heraldic navy, collegiate crimson, quiet library grey.
inspiration: University heraldic colours (Oxford blue, Harvard crimson) — https://www.ox.ac.uk/public-affairs/style-guide/digital-style-guide

neutralHue.intent: cool paper grey, faint blue

name: Memphis Pop
mood: Music and culture: turquoise, bubblegum and lemon — loud, irreverent, 80s.
inspiration: Memphis Group (Ettore Sottsass, Milan 1981) — https://www.vam.ac.uk/articles/memphis-group

neutralHue.intent: bright white with a whisper of warmth; dark mode is aubergine-free charcoal

name: Werner Moss
mood: Eco and natural: lichen olive, ochre earth, unbleached linen.
inspiration: Werner's Nomenclature of Colours (1814, used by Darwin) — https://www.c82.net/werner/

neutralHue.intent: linen grey with a yellow-green cast

name: Plum Market
mood: Boutique retail: ripe plum with saffron price-tag pops.
inspiration: Liberty London fabric archive and spice-market stalls (plum + saffron pairing) — https://www.libertylondon.com/uk/info/our-heritage

neutralHue.intent: rosy off-white and plum-black; neutral tinted toward brand

note: Plum is a red-purple (hue ~340 OKLCH), far from indigo; no gradients.

name: Riso Zine
mood: Indie publishing: risograph federal blue with fluorescent pink overprint.
inspiration: Riso ink colour library (Federal Blue, Fluorescent Pink, Sunflower, Green) — https://www.stencil.wtf/colors

neutralHue.intent: uncoated-paper grey, neutral-warm

name: Salmon Paper
mood: Serious editorial and business news: salmon newsprint, claret masthead, oxford teal.
inspiration: Financial Times Origami colour system (paper/claret/teal; hues adjusted) — https://origami.ft.com/foundations/colours/

neutralHue.intent: salmon-pink paper by day, warm charcoal by night

note: Salmon, not cream; claret, not terracotta. Avoid pairing with hairline-rule broadsheet layout tell.

name: Nordic Frost
mood: Dark-led productivity: polar-night base, frost blues, aurora status colours.
inspiration: Nord theme by Arctic Ice Studio — https://www.nordtheme.com/docs/colors-and-palettes

neutralHue.intent: cool blue-grey polar night (Nord0) and snow storm (Nord6)

note: Blue-grey neutral sits near Tailwind slate; the bluish-frost brand and aurora accents keep it distinct.

name: Saffron Kitchen
mood: Food and hospitality: toasted saffron, cardamom teal, warm plaster.
inspiration: Indian spice markets and Rajasthani painted walls; Pantone 'Saffron' family — https://www.pantone.com/color-finder/14-1064-TCX

neutralHue.intent: warm plaster white, roasted brown-black

name: Morandi Studio
mood: Architecture and studio practice: dusty rose-clay, sage, chalky plaster.
inspiration: Giorgio Morandi's still lifes (muted, greyed 'Morandi colours') — https://www.museomorandi.it/

neutralHue.intent: chalky greige, low chroma, warm

name: Hi-Vis
mood: Logistics and industrial: graphite steel with safety-yellow action.
inspiration: ISO 3864 safety colours and Herman Miller / Vitra industrial signage — https://www.iso.org/standard/51021.html
echoesTell: Deliberately echoes 'near-black + single acid accent' (graphite + safety yellow). Justified for industrial/logistics where hi-vis is the domain's own vocabulary; avoid as a generic default.

neutralHue.intent: neutral steel grey, no hue

name: Signal Orange
mood: Sports and fitness: high-energy orange on cool track-grey, teal for recovery.
inspiration: Strava's orange-led activity UI and athletics track markings (hue darkened for AA) — https://www.strava.com/

neutralHue.intent: cool grey with a faint blue, to make the orange pop

note: Saturated orange on cool grey — not desaturated terracotta on cream.

name: Burle Marx
mood: Travel and landscape: jungle green, bougainvillea pink, sun-bleached sand.
inspiration: Roberto Burle Marx's tropical modernist gardens and Copacabana promenade — https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/1449

neutralHue.intent: sun-bleached sand by day, deep green-black by night
